title: DMFC prior-contrast reconstruction from selected spike counts
scientific_question: Can the participant correctly reconstruct the signed raw and training-clock-adjusted short-minus-long neural population contrasts from every supplied selected-count observation, including all oriented intermediate quantities?
primary_outputs: Exact protocol-defined raw/adjusted means, oriented differences, stratum/bin products, bin averages, two scalars and training-only nuisance coefficients, computed independently from the provided counts. A larger positive effect is not a better answer.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: uint32 counts tensor[177,40,15], exact trial/unit IDs and15 half-open50ms bins covering[Set-.75s,Set).
Cue metadata includes trial ID, split, short-prior indicator, eye/reach modality, direction, Ready time and Set time.
Fixed task/public contract/manifest; all129 training rows followed by48 validation rows, chronological within split.
forbidden_inputs: Full NWB, produced intervals, Go times, outcome flags and held-out-unit spikes
Reference result arrays and private operator receipts
Changing the extraction, dropping cells/trials, validation-fitted nuisance scales/coefficients or selecting only positive effects
allowed_inputs.case_identity: One exact manifest binds177 trial IDs,40 units,15 bin edges and row ordering. Concrete IDs are held in the separately provisioned public packet, not reconstructed from a task title.
allowed_inputs.split: 129 training and48 validation trials in the declared selected panel. Fit nuisance OLS and clock/duration scaling on training only; apply unchanged to validation. Validation is used in the oriented train-by-validation contrast, not as held-out tp labels.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All177 trials,40 units,15 bins,4 strata,2 priors and11 finite oriented output arrays are mandatory. Selected counts are a narrower named assay than the original broad trajectory/interval specification; no new benchmark ID is added.

biological_unit: One already exposed monkey/session;177 trials,40 units and15 bins do not provide animal-level replication.
case_definition: One complete177-trial selected-count panel, jointly analyzed across four response-modality/direction strata, two priors and two splits.

split.policy: 129 training and48 validation trials in the declared selected panel. Fit nuisance OLS and clock/duration scaling on training only; apply unchanged to validation. Validation is used in the oriented train-by-validation contrast, not as held-out tp labels.
split.coverage: All177 trials,40 units,15 bins,4 strata,2 priors and11 finite oriented output arrays are mandatory. Selected counts are a narrower named assay than the original broad trajectory/interval specification; no new benchmark ID is added.

reference.role: Pinned NLB NWB/tensor/evaluation source. Its response-aligned neural-speed metric is retrospective; direct prospective interval prediction needs a separately qualified packet and scorer.

controls: Use ddof=0 training-only scales per stratum; constant training duration removes only that column with zero coefficients in its slot.
Require at least p+1 training rows, SVD tolerance max(n,p)*eps64*smax and condition number<=1e8; no fallback, regularization or outcome-based row removal.
Retain intercept/prior contributions when subtracting clock, squared-clock and duration effects.
Orient differences short-minus-long, weight four strata and15 bins equally, and preserve signed negative products.
Public prior labels are required covariates for reconstruction, not concealed prediction targets.

direct_observation.representation: The operative endpoint requires full177x40x15 arithmetic and11 exact output blocks; a few plotted traces would change the assay.
direct_observation.boundary: A direct chart-interpretation task would need separate questions/ground truth; no scalar-only stand-in for complete reconstruction.
missing: No direct interpretation endpoint or complete no-tools observation transport.

typed_viewer.representation: Plots may aid investigation, but typed images alone do not preserve this full numerical reconstruction target.
typed_viewer.boundary: A viewer summary cannot replace all counts or the11 required oriented blocks; any auxiliary viewer condition needs an explicitly separate interpretation endpoint.
missing: No typed viewer implementation or viewer-specific assessment.

tool_assisted.representation: Natural fit is a numerical investigation over the full supplied count/metadata packet with complete arithmetic outputs.
tool_assisted.boundary: No private references or target feedback; capture code/method and changed-input response, not merely final stored numbers.
missing: Current authenticated per-case investigation transport and complete executable scorer.

frozen_program.representation: Historical programme interface emitted all11 blocks from a fixed public packet; replacement source is declared but not present/qualified here.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code before observation and remove producer before reference scoring; exposed originals alone do not test memorization.
missing: Recover pinned dependency and current runner; validate changed-input execution before an input-understanding claim.

primary.name: absolute errors of both raw and adjusted scalar contrasts, conditional on complete oriented-block evaluation
primary.aggregation: One full-panel result; both scalar errors and every11-block RMSE/max-absolute/signed-mean error must be reported together. No scalar-only rank is valid.
primary.rationale: Reversing both prior differences or changing coefficients can preserve scalar products; oriented intermediate values and training normal equations detect such false reconstruction.

secondary: All11 oriented block errors and public arithmetic consistency diagnostics.
Training-only OLS normal-equation checks with declared full-rank/condition-number gates.
Whole-panel coverage and explicit abstained/unsupported states.
Changed-input reconstruction and stale-answer controls are required to support input dependence; historical scale controls qualify only tested developer code.

comparators.name: independent fixed-protocol numerical reference
comparators.inputs: Same selected counts and permitted cue metadata
comparators.procedure: sqrt(counts) float64; equal-stratum and equal-bin train-difference times validation-difference contrasts, oriented short-minus-long. Fit per-stratum training OLS[1,is_short,z_clock,z_clock²,z_duration] and subtract only nuisance contributions before recomputing.

comparators.name: double-prior-reversal and wrong-coefficient controls
comparators.procedure: Historical controls can give zero scalar error while failing oriented blocks; preserve these counterexamples and require full-block assessment.

comparators.name: changed-input and stale-answer control
comparators.inputs: Separately constructed count perturbation with newly computed operator reference
comparators.procedure: Prior documentation records developer scale sensitivity. A new participant must demonstrate response to newly frozen inputs without protected-reference access before an anti-copying interpretation.

nuisance_controls: Use ddof=0 training-only scales per stratum; constant training duration removes only that column with zero coefficients in its slot.
Require at least p+1 training rows, SVD tolerance max(n,p)*eps64*smax and condition number<=1e8; no fallback, regularization or outcome-based row removal.
Retain intercept/prior contributions when subtracting clock, squared-clock and duration effects.
Orient differences short-minus-long, weight four strata and15 bins equally, and preserve signed negative products.
Public prior labels are required covariates for reconstruction, not concealed prediction targets.
evaluation.uncertainty: Numerical tolerances measure engineering agreement, not scientific significance. The one-session descriptive effect has no animal-population confidence interval. Any scientific prior-effect inference requires a separately prespecified repeated-data/temporal design.
evaluation.failure_policy: Exact JSON/NPZ schema and all11 finite little-endian float64 arrays required; partial complete answers are invalid. Whole abstention has coverage0 and null numerical metrics without private reference load. Finite inaccurate answers retain their errors; arithmetic overflow is explicit unsupported-numerics, never clipped.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.

holds.requirement: Verify context/prior labels and overlapping interval support; latent geometry is not proof of a uniquely identified mechanism.
